node.title: L1 joint core/background Johnson bound
node.statement: For one exact support cell, choose u=ell-(h-d) background agreements per contributor. The common-defect and common-background locators divide the same nonzero cross determinant, so |D_1 intersect D_2|+|R_1 intersect R_2|<=r=2d-h. A joint incidence second moment gives |Z|<=Nb ell/(bd^2+Nu^2-Nbr)<=n^3 whenever the denominator is positive. Thus fixed petal polarity is polynomial there. In tail variables a=N-d and c=N-h, every counterfamily satisfies b a^2+N(ell-a+c)^2<=Nbc. The exact F_17 chart attains the positive bound with two contributors; the exact F_23 nonsplit chart has two contributors at zero denominator, so strictness is load-bearing.
